The host's time zone.

```hcl
step "example" {
  timezone {
    name = "..."
  }
}
```

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | Yes | IANA time zone, such as Europe/Dublin or UTC. |

## Read-only attributes

Conn3x sets these; reference them as `conn3x_timezone.<circuit>__<step>["<host>"].<name>`.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `in_sync` | bool | Whether the host has this setting. |

A step lowers to the `conn3x_timezone` resource, one instance per host, and connects with its circuit's `ssh` block.
